tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: dim_client
    description: "Client dimension. One row per client household/individual with demographics, segmentation, contact info, risk profile, and primary advisor linkage."
    config:
      domain: 'Client'
    columns:
      - name: client_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: client_id
        description: "FSC account ID (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: client_name
        description: "Full name"
      - name: client_segment
        description: "HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, Institutional"
      - name: service_model
        description: "Service tier"
      - name: risk_tolerance
        description: "Risk tolerance profile"
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "Primary advisor FK"
      - name: total_aum
        description: "Total AUM across all accounts"

  - name: dim_advisor
    description: "Advisor dimension. One row per advisor with role, team, region, credentials, and book metrics."
    config:
      domain: 'Advisor'
    columns:
      - name: advisor_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "FSC advisor ID (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: advisor_name
        description: "Full name"
      - name: role
        description: "Advisor role"
      - name: team_name
        description: "Team name"
      - name: region
        description: "Team region"
      - name: client_count
        description: "Active client count"
      - name: total_aum
        description: "Total book AUM"

  - name: dim_account
    description: "Account dimension. One row per financial account with registration, type, custodian, model, and status."
    config:
      domain: 'Account'
    columns:
      - name: account_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: financial_account_id
        description: "FSC financial account ID (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: account_number
        description: "Custodian account number"
      - name: account_name
        description: "Display name"
      - name: registration_type
        description: "Individual, Joint, Trust, Custodial"
      - name: account_type
        description: "Brokerage, IRA, 401k, Trust, etc."
      - name: status
        description: "Current account status"
      - name: custodian_code
        description: "SCHW, PERS, or FIDL"
      - name: client_id
        description: "Client FK"
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "Advisor FK"

  - name: dim_security
    description: "Security dimension. One row per security with ticker, CUSIP, asset class, sector, and type."
    config:
      domain: 'Security'
    columns:
      - name: security_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: ticker
        description: "Resolved ticker symbol"
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: cusip
        description: "Resolved CUSIP"
      - name: security_name
        description: "Security display name"
      - name: asset_class
        description: "Asset class"
      - name: sector
        description: "Market sector"
      - name: security_type
        description: "Security type"
